subject: Re: Data residency & deployment mode — EU/APAC availability
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Petrova <elena@novabank.eu>, Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@itfinance.it>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-08T15:12:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap — data residency & deployment modes

Hi Elena / Luca —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

1) Summary of needs you surfaced
- Primary requirement: all customer PII and model inputs must remain in the EU (data residency) for production traffic.
- Secondary: evaluate APAC region availability for future expansion / disaster recovery.
- Interested in both Hosted API (fastest onboard) and Dedicated capacity (predictable throughput / isolation). Private VPC/on-prem is a hard requirement for a subset of workloads that handle highly regulated documents.

2) What Redwood can offer (high level)
- Hosted API: we can enforce EU data residency by pinning tenants to eu-region clusters (eu-west-1). This keeps data and logs in-region; cross-region routing only happens if you opt in for cross-region failover.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools deployed in EU or APAC regions; good fit if you need performance isolation and predictable SLOs.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): deploy our control plane in your VPC or an on-prem bundle — full network isolation, KMS integration, and audit log exports. On-prem options require lead time for SOW and engineering (~8–12 weeks typical).

3) Compliance materials attached: Redwood_Dedicated_Overview.pdf, SOC2-Report-Redacted.pdf. I also attached a short compliance questions workbook you started in the call (Compliance_Questions_NordBank.xlsx).

4) Open questions from us
- For the workloads that must be on Private: do you expect a VPC deployment (AWS/Azure) or fully air-gapped on-prem hardware?
- For APAC: is there an immediate go-live requirement or is this a roadmap item (6–12 months)?

Next steps
- I propose a technical deep-dive next week with Marissa (solutions engineering) to validate network/architecture and confirm SOW scope.
- Please review the attached docs; if you can share your list of compliance endpoints (or add to the workbook) we’ll confirm answers in the tech call.

Availability: I can do Mon/Tue morning (CEST) or Wed afternoon. 

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Petrova <elena@novabank.eu>

Date: 2026-07-08T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — data residency & deployment modes

Thanks Aditya — useful summary. A couple of clarifying questions before we lock a tech session: 

- When you say Hosted API can be pinned to eu-west-1, does that guarantee that model inputs, logs, and KV cache never leave the EU? We have a compliance requirement that tokens and logs must not be routed outside the EU under normal operations.
- For APAC: we have a small pilot in Singapore planned for Q4 — is there an APAC region you already run in and what is the expected timeline for availability?
- For Private: is the VPC deployment simply a managed control plane running in our AWS account (we use Azure for most infra but can open an AWS account if required), or do you have an Azure/VNet option and an on-prem appliance?

Also, can you confirm whether you provide a redacted SOC2 and a current list of sub-processors? I’ll need those for our risk/compliance team. Attaching a short list of compliance questions we’ll add tomorrow.

Best,
Elena
Head of Cloud Risk & Compliance, NordBank
(elena@novabank.eu)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Petrova <elena@novabank.eu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-09T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — data residency & deployment modes

Elena —

Thanks for the questions; looping in Marissa (SE) and Neha (AM) to cover technical + commercial details. Quick answers up front, we'll expand in the tech session: 

- Hosted API (EU pinning): When a tenant is pinned to our EU clusters (eu-west-1), runtime inference traffic, model inputs, generated outputs, and our short-term KV cache are held in-region. Audit logs and metrics can be configured to export only to your EU storage (S3/GCS in EU). Cross-region routing is disabled by default; we only enable failover if you request multi-region DR.

- APAC availability: We have a production cluster in ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) for Dedicated and Private deployments; Hosted API coverage in APAC is planned but SLA-backed Hosted in APAC is currently limited — Dedicated pools in APAC are the faster route for guaranteed locality. If Singapore is a priority for the pilot, we can propose Dedicated capacity there with a 4–8 week lead time depending on GPU sizing.

- Private (VPC/on-prem): We support:
  * VPC-deployed control plane in customer AWS or Azure accounts (we have an Azure marketplace template + ARM/Terraform modules).
  * On-prem package for air-gapped environments (requires SOW; typical delivery 8–12 weeks).

- Compliance artifacts: attaching SOC2 redacted (SOC2-Report-Redacted.pdf). Our sub-processors list is included in the SOC2 appendix; happy to extract and send a standalone list if helpful.

Actions:
- Marissa: can you confirm network requirements for the VPC template and if Azure Marketplace deployment is a straightforward option for NordBank?
- Neha: I’ll need a rough Dedicated pricing/commitment ballpark for NordBank for the pilot (small pool in SG + EU fallback) — can you prepare a 1-pager prior to the tech call?

Proposed tech call: Tue 2026-07-14 09:00 CEST / 08:00 BST — does that work for you?

Thanks,
Aditya
